# GreenGuard AI — Offline Energy Claim & Green Finance Verification Manifest

> GreenGuard AI (https://greenguard.argrowthlab.pk) is an offline-capable document intelligence and quantitative audit engine designed for bank green-finance underwriters, corporate sustainability auditors, and ESG risk committees. The platform mathematically audits corporate energy-efficiency claims and solar generation figures against 24-month utility meter telemetry, bi-directional inverter logs, and NASA POWER agroclimatology data with zero external data leakage.

## System Architecture & Technical Specifications

- Core Philosophy: Complete air-gapped data sovereignty with zero third-party cloud data transmission.
- Quantitative Engine: Deterministic Python Decimal arithmetic adhering to ISO 14064-2 greenhouse gas project quantification principles and IPMVP (International Performance Measurement and Verification Protocol).
- Extraction Layer: ChromaDB offline vector database paired with local Ollama deep-reasoning models and page-cited document intelligence.
- Climatology Ground-Truth: NASA POWER API historical solar irradiance (ALLSKY_SFC_SW_DWN) and ambient temperature (T2M) regional baselines across Pakistan.
- Algorithmic Fairness: Subgroup demographic and regional False Positive Rate (FPR) disparity auditing enforcing <= 10% tolerance across all industrial slices (C03).
- Adversarial Robustness: Three-stage sanitization, reference clipping, and median smoothing defense neutralizing subtle +-2% input evasion attempts (C09).

## Verification Workspaces

### 1. Electricity Bill & Sustainability Claim Check
- URL: https://greenguard.argrowthlab.pk/electricity-claim-check
- Target Evidence: Corporate Sustainability PDF Reports vs. 24-Month Utility Meter Electricity Bills (CSV/JSON).
- Methodology: ChromaDB extracts quantitative claims with page-level citations. Python Decimal math cross-examines claimed baseline, reporting period consumption, and operating days against actual metered intervals to detect over-claiming, ghost baselines, or uncredited facility shutdowns.
- Outputs: Audit verification verdict (VERIFIED_ACCURATE, DISCREPANCY_DETECTED, FRAUDULENT_OVERCLAIM), discrepancy percentage, confidence score, and downloadable audit trail.

### 2. Solar Generation, NASA Weather & Zero-Bill Rebound Check
- URL: https://greenguard.argrowthlab.pk/solar-zero-bill-check
- Target Evidence: Dedicated Commercial Solar Inverter Generation Logs & Bi-directional Net-Metering Utility CSVs.
- Methodology: Compares actual metered solar output against NASA POWER weather-expected yield (irradiance kWh/m2/day derated at -0.4%/degC above 25degC standard test condition). Formulates facility balance (Grid Import + Solar Generated - Grid Export) and cross-checks against scikit-learn expected demand to detect technical inverter faults, dust/soiling losses, and rebound consumption masked by zero bills.
- Outputs: Weather health diagnostic (Normal Weather Variance, Technical Fault Suspected, Exaggerated Generation Claim), facility energy balance, rebound gap kWh, and maintenance action items.

### 3. Regional Fairness & Adversarial Robustness Audit
- URL: https://greenguard.argrowthlab.pk/fairness-and-robustness
- Target Directives: C03 Algorithmic Fairness & C09 Adversarial Perturbation Defense.
- Methodology: Evaluates slice-based False Positive Rate (FPR) disparity across Pakistani provinces (Sindh, Punjab, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Balochistan) and enterprise tiers (SME vs. Tier-1 Corporate) to guarantee compliance within a <= 10% parity margin. Subjected to automated +-2% non-critical feature perturbation attacks with 3-stage clipping and temporal smoothing defense.
- Outputs: Regional disparity matrix, demographic parity delta, adversarial stress-test attack vs. defended comparison, and cryptographically hashed verification certificate.
